verses.t: By the night when it covers
verses.pickthall: By the night enshrouding

verses.t: And [by] the day when it appears
verses.pickthall: And the day resplendent

verses.t: And [by] He who created the male and female
verses.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female

verses.t: Indeed, your efforts are diverse
verses.pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends)

verses.t: As for he who gives and fears Allah
verses.pickthall: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

verses.t: And believes in the best [reward]
verses.pickthall: And believeth in goodness

verses.t: We will ease him toward ease
verses.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease

verses.t: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
verses.pickthall: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent

verses.t: And denies the best [reward]
verses.pickthall: And disbelieveth in goodness

verses.t: We will ease him toward difficulty
verses.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity

verses.t: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls
verses.pickthall: His riches will not save him when he perisheth

verses.t: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance
verses.pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

verses.t: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]
verses.pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former

verses.t: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing
verses.pickthall: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire

verses.t: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
verses.pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure

verses.t: Who had denied and turned away
verses.pickthall: He who denieth and turneth away

verses.t: But the righteous one will avoid it
verses.pickthall: Far removed from it will be the righteous

verses.t: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
verses.pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness)

verses.t: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
verses.pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward

verses.t: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High
verses.pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High

verses.t: And he is going to be satisfied
verses.pickthall: He verily will be content
